{{Vanilla|Tooltip}}
<div style="float:right;clear:right;margin:0 0 1em 1em;text-align:right">{{Tooltip|Electrum Helmet}}<br />{{Tooltip|Apple Empanada}}</div>
The '''tooltip''' of a [[Matcha Flavoured]] item is rewritten to be read at a glance. The pack hides the vanilla attribute lines ("When in Main Hand: …") and replaces them with short lore lines that start with a symbol, such as {{G|Attack damage}} 6 or {{G|Armor}} 3.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/shakudo_helmet.json}}</ref> The symbols are characters of the resource pack's font, drawn in <code>font/custom_emojis.png</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/font/default.json}}</ref> This page lists what each symbol means.

== Equipment stats ==
Weapons, tools and armor list their stats as dark green lines. Each is a symbol followed by a number.<ref name="lang">{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! Symbol !! Meaning !! Example
|-
| {{G|Attack damage|size=16px}} || Attack damage || [[Copper Sword|copper sword]]
|-
| {{G|Attack speed|size=16px}} || Attack cooldown, in seconds between full-strength hits || weapons
|-
| {{G|Mining speed|size=16px}} || Mining speed || tools
|-
| {{G|Armor|size=16px}} || Armor points || armor
|-
| {{G|Toughness|size=16px}} || Armor toughness || [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] and better armor
|-
| {{G|Knockback resistance|size=16px}} || Knockback resistance || [[Steel equipment|steel]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] armor
|-
| {{G|Knockback|size=16px}} || Extra attack knockback || steel weapons
|-
| {{G|Speed|size=16px}} || Movement speed while held or worn || [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] equipment
|-
| {{G|Reach|size=16px}} || Change in interaction range || [[cleaver]] (−1); the [[crook]]'s line is broken, see [[Known bugs]]
|-
| {{G|Safe fall distance|size=16px}} || Extra safe fall distance || [[Leather armor|leather]] and [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] armor
|-
| {{G|Step height|size=16px}} || Extra step height || sturdy leather boots
|-
| {{G|Throwable|size=16px}} || The item can be thrown || [[Pickled Warped Fungus|pickled fungi]] and [[Bubbling Mead|bubbling mead]]
|}
[[Claymore]]s add "When Blocking:" and percentages for "Melee Blocking" and "Projectile Blocking". The last lines, "Repaired with:" and an item name, give the material an [[anvil]] accepts for [[repairing]].

== Intrinsics ==
Lines in color below the stats are [[intrinsic]] enchantments, which the pack stores on the item and shows by symbol instead of by name.<ref name="lang" /> "∞" means the effect lasts as long as the item is worn or held; a number is a level; a time in brackets is how often the effect repeats.
{| class="wikitable"
! Symbol !! Meaning !! Found on
|-
| {{G|Warding|size=16px}} 1–3 || [[Warding]] level || [[Warding Sword|warding sword]], [[Warding Shield|warding shield]], [[jewelry]]
|-
| {{G|Electrum|size=16px}} +1 || One more level of warding per piece || [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] armor
|-
| {{G|Apotropaic|size=16px}} Max || [[Apotropaic]]: maximum warding || full electrum set
|-
| {{G|Magic protection|size=16px}} 8 / 20 || [[Magic protection]] || [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] armor (8), [[Elytra#Shakudo Elytra|shakudo elytra]] (20)
|-
| {{G|Cleanse|size=16px}} Cleanses: … || [[Cleanse]]: removes the listed effects || shakudo armor
|-
| {{G|Half heart|size=16px}} {{G|Cooldown|size=16px}} (00:30) || Heals half a heart every 30 seconds; the set bonus line shortens the interval || shakudo armor
|-
| {{G|Health|size=16px}}{{G|Health|size=16px}} {{G|Cooldown|size=16px}} (00:30) || [[Divinity]]: 2 hearts of Absorption every 30 seconds || full adamant or electrum set
|-
| {{G|Doom|size=16px}} 3, {{G|Doom set|size=16px}} 4 || [[Doom]] per piece and as a set bonus || adamant armor
|-
| {{G|Health|size=16px}}{{G|Attack damage|size=16px}} || Life steal: regeneration after each hit || shakudo weapons
|-
| {{G|Weakness|size=16px}} || Inflicts Weakness II on hit || adamant weapons and axe
|-
| {{G|Smelting|size=16px}} || Smelts mined blocks || adamant tools
|-
| {{G|Fortune|size=16px}} || Fortune III || electrum tools
|-
| {{G|Health|size=16px}} ∞, {{G|Mining speed|size=16px}} ∞, {{G|Fire|size=16px}} ∞, {{G|Water|size=16px}} ∞ || Constant Regeneration, Haste, Fire Resistance, Conduit Power || [[jewelry]]
|}
"Set Bonus:" introduces lines that need all four armor pieces, and "Per Equipment Bonus:" lines that stack with each piece worn. See [[Set bonus]]. "Elytra Bonus:" marks the bonus of the [[Elytra#Shakudo Elytra|shakudo elytra]].

== Food and potions ==
The first line of a [[food]]'s tooltip shows the healing as red hearts, one heart per 2 health points. The lines below list the effects with their symbol and duration, for example {{G|Armor}} Resistance (20:00) on a [[Pumpkin Curry|pumpkin curry]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/pumpkin_curry.json}}</ref> Several effects share a symbol:

== Advancements and chat ==
In [[advancements]], {{G|Obol}} is one [[obol]] of reward and {{G|Broken heart}} marks a milestone that lowers the player's minimum hearts; see [[Advancements#Rewards]]. {{G|Matcha}} starts the message "Matcha Flavoured is now loaded" shown when the datapack loads.<ref name="lang" />
